quickReviewNote: Open Items and inspect the proposed adjustments
homeIntro: See what is installed and running in the background. Review every adjustment before applying. Restore settings from history
safeNote: Only verified adjustments with lower risk
balancedNote: Includes compatible power options and additional adjustments
aggressiveNote: More verified adjustments, without selecting high-risk items
customNote: Choose items and review each risk
cancelled: Analysis cancelled. No changes were made
complete: Analysis complete. No changes were made
idle: Run an analysis to inspect current values
safeDefaultNote: Analysis does not change registry, services, tasks or apps. Applying requires review and Windows authorization
metricsLater: Choose only features you do not use and review the risks of each item
autoRevert: Restore the original value from history
manualRevert: Reinstall through Microsoft Store. Original data and version are not recovered
appsIntro: Only installed catalog apps eligible for removal appear here. Each app needs your consent
scopeNote: Without administrator access, inventory covers only your user. Authorized removal affects all users and new profiles
noUndoDetail: App removal cannot be reversed by the journal. Reinstall opens the Store and does not recover data, original version or provisioning
noApps: No removable catalog apps were found in this analysis
reviewIntro: No changes have been made. Acknowledge the risks below to continue
ackNoUndo: I understand Undo does not reinstall this app or recover its data
ackRisk: I have read and accept this item's risk
ackUnverified: I reviewed the sources and accept this unverified item
ackAll: I reviewed this operation and authorize it
uac: Windows will request authorization. The helper exits when finished
executing: Waiting for authorization and operation completion
operationError: The operation could not be completed. Check history before trying again
emptyHistory: No applied settings in this history
protectedHistoryNote: Authorize reading to inspect the journal and removed apps. This does not change settings
recover: Some changes are incomplete. Review history and undo before applying again
privacyNote: No account, telemetry, update check or network calls. Only explicitly opening the Store leaves the app
advancedNote: Show technical state and unverified items for manual review
localPrefs: Language, theme and advanced mode are stored only on this device
notInstalled: Run an analysis to list apps
reviewRequired: Prepare a new review to continue
readError: Some targets could not be queried. Unknown state does not mean absence
analysis_busy: Wait for running queries to finish
uac_cancelled: Windows authorization cancelled. No operation was started
operation_failed: The operation could not be completed. Check history before retrying
identity_mismatch: The connection identity does not match this session
ui_must_not_elevate: Open the window from a regular terminal. The interface must not run as administrator
timeout: The response timed out. Check history before retrying
replay: This authorization has already been used. Prepare a new review
invalid_payload: The message was rejected for security
undoReview: Restore the original settings recorded in the journal
reinstallReview: Open the validated app page in Microsoft Store. You complete installation in the Store
historyReview: Read protected history without changing settings
catalog_mismatch: The application files have different versions. Use files from the same package
